messages.author: nguerin
messages.body:
Hello,
This is probably a very simple question, but when I am reading about
file formats on the Amber website, what is the standard that the format
specifiers are using? For example, in the Force Field Parameter File
Specification
https://ambermd.org/FileFormats.php#parm.dat
what does something like
FORMAT(A2,2X,F10.2x,f10.2)
mean?
A pointer to the relevant definitions would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you,
Nate Guerin
Donald Lab
Duke University

messages.author: Thomas Cheatham
messages.body:
FORMAT is the way numbers, letters, etc. are interpreted in the Fortran language. See, for example:
https://web.stanford.edu/class/me200c/tutorial_77/17_format.html
--tec3
